Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question by redefining “older” to mean “older at each film’s release” instead of the straightforward comparison of the directors’ birthdates (absolute age). With the correct interpretation, William Bertram (born 1880), director of Neal of the Navy, is older than Yuliya Solntseva (born 1901), director of The Enchanted Desna. This incorrect criterion would lead to the wrong film being identified as having the older director.
